cold_start_interpretation: Inconclusive: a pre-existing Chrome tab was open at batchfence.onrender.com. The preserved app polls /api/health every 15000 ms (frontend/main.tsx). The planned idle wait was cancelled; the final check deliberately used idle_ms=0. Initial access was warm, not a measured cold start. No user tab was closed.
